english.title: Simultaneously release between 2000 and 10000 small balloons without permission of CAA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused or permitted a group of small balloons of more than 2,000 but not more than 10,000 in number to be simultaneously released at a single site within

(A)_[airspace notified for the purposes of Article 93(1) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(B)_[the aerodrome traffic zone of a notified aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), during the notified operating hours of that aerodrome,]_

without the permission of the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to Articles 93(1)(b) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
